customer_concentration.grouping_method: Revenue consolidated to economic customer group using COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id); parent customer name used when parent exists. One child row in dim_customer rolled into parent group.

evidence.query: WITH rev AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) AS group_customer_name, SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer p ON c.parent_customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) ), ranked AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, group_customer_name, revenue_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC, group_customer_id) AS rn FROM rev ), totals AS ( SELECT SUM(revenue_usd) AS total_revenue_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 1 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top1_revenue_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 3 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top3_revenue_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 5 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top5_revenue_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top10_revenue_usd FROM ranked ) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * top1_revenue_usd / total_revenue_usd, 2) AS top_1_pct, ROUND(100.0 * top3_revenue_usd / total_revenue_usd, 2) AS top_3_pct, ROUND(100.0 * top5_revenue_usd / total_revenue_usd, 2) AS top_5_pct, ROUND(100.0 * top10_revenue_usd / total_revenue_usd, 2) AS top_10_pct, ROUND(total_revenue_usd,2) AS total_revenue_usd FROM totals
evidence.methodology: Aggregated FY2025 invoice-line revenue to parent customer group where parent_customer_id exists, ranked groups by revenue, summed top N group revenue, and divided by total FY2025 revenue entirely in SQL.

evidence.query: WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) AS snapshot_month, SUM(fsm.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON fsm.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) ), hist AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY group_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prior_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN arr_usd > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY group_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS had_positive_before FROM monthly ), classified AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, prior_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr = 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) = 0 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS new_logo_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr > 0 AND arr_usd > prior_arr THEN arr_usd - prior_arr ELSE 0 END AS expansion_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr > 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND arr_usd < prior_arr THEN prior_arr - arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS contraction_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr > 0 AND arr_usd = 0 THEN prior_arr ELSE 0 END AS churned_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr = 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) = 1 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS reactivation_arr FROM hist ), agg AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(new_logo_arr),2) AS new_logo_arr, ROUND(SUM(expansion_arr),2) AS expansion_arr, ROUND(SUM(contraction_arr),2) AS contraction_arr, ROUND(SUM(churned_arr),2) AS churned_arr, ROUND(SUM(reactivation_arr),2) AS reactivation_arr FROM classified ), begin_end AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2024-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS beginning_arr, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2025-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS ending_arr FROM monthly ) SELECT beginning_arr, new_logo_arr, expansion_arr, contraction_arr, churned_arr, reactivation_arr, ending_arr, ROUND(beginning_arr + new_logo_arr + expansion_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr + reactivation_arr,2) AS reconciled_ending_arr, ROUND(ending_arr - (beginning_arr + new_logo_arr + expansion_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr + reactivation_arr),2) AS reconciliation_diff FROM begin_end CROSS JOIN agg
evidence.methodology: Monthly ARR history aggregated to economic customer group and classified using prior-month ARR plus full historical positive ARR flag to distinguish new logo from reactivation. FY2025 movement categories were summed in SQL and reconciled exactly from 2024-12 beginning ARR to 2025-12 ending ARR.

retention.methodology: Starting cohort consists of economic customer groups with positive ARR at 2024-12-01. NRR equals ending ARR at 2025-12-01 for the starting cohort divided by starting ARR. GRR equals sum of LEAST(start_arr,end_arr) across the starting cohort divided by starting ARR; this excludes expansion benefit but allows reactivated ARR to contribute up to original starting ARR where the customer returned by period end. Logo churn equals starting cohort customers with zero ARR at 2025-12-01 divided by starting cohort count, i.e., customers churned and still inactive at period end rather than gross intra-period churn events.

evidence.query: WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) AS snapshot_month, SUM(fsm.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON fsm.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) ), cohort AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2024-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS start_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2025-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS end_arr FROM monthly GROUP BY group_customer_id HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2024-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) > 0 ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS starting_logo_count, ROUND(SUM(start_arr),2) AS starting_arr, ROUND(SUM(end_arr),2) AS ending_arr_for_starting_cohort, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(end_arr) / SUM(start_arr),2) AS nrr_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(LEAST(start_arr,end_arr)) / SUM(start_arr),2) AS grr_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN end_arr = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned_logo_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN end_arr = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),2) AS logo_churn_pct FROM cohort
evidence.methodology: Cohort-based retention calculated at economic customer-group level using December 2024 starting ARR and December 2025 ending ARR from monthly subscription history.

recurring_revenue.methodology: Management-tagged recurring revenue uses recorded invoice-line revenue_type tags containing recurring/subscription semantics. Independently restated recurring revenue requires product evidence of subscription/recurring delivery model or product family plus both service_period_start and service_period_end on the invoice line. This methodology is stricter than management tagging and preserves only structured-evidence-supported recurring revenue.

evidence.query: WITH revenue_tagged AS ( SELECT YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS period_year, SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(il.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(il.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' THEN il.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS management_tagged_recurring_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND il.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND il.service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN il.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS restated_recurring_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND (il.service_period_start IS NULL OR il.service_period_end IS NULL) THEN il.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ambiguous_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON il.product_id = p.product_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ) SELECT period_year, ROUND(total_revenue,2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(management_tagged_recurring_revenue,2) AS management_tagged_recurring_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * management_tagged_recurring_revenue / total_revenue,2) AS management_tagged_recurring_pct, ROUND(restated_recurring_revenue,2) AS restated_recurring_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * restated_recurring_revenue / total_revenue,2) AS restated_recurring_pct, ROUND(management_tagged_recurring_revenue - restated_recurring_revenue,2) AS reclassified_revenue, ROUND(ambiguous_revenue,2) AS ambiguous_revenue FROM revenue_tagged
evidence.methodology: Compared management revenue_type tagging with an independent recurring test based on product recurring semantics plus service-period evidence, all calculated on FY2025 invoice-line revenue in SQL.

collections_quality.dso_methodology: Proxy only: period-end unpaid December 2025 invoiced amount divided by December 2025 invoice amount times days in month. This is not a full traditional DSO using complete AR balances and should be treated as a limited period-end proxy because structured data lacks an explicit receivables balance table or due-date-based open AR ledger.
collections_quality.weighted_collection_days_methodology: Invoice-value-weighted average of days_outstanding for FY2025 invoices using fact_collection joined to fact_invoice. Reported separately from DSO.

weighted_collection_days.query: WITH invoice_base AS ( SELECT i.invoice_id, i.customer_id, CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE) AS invoice_date, i.invoice_amount_usd, fc.amount_paid_usd, CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date, fc.days_outstanding, fc.status AS collection_status FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON i.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 ), paid AS ( SELECT * FROM invoice_base WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL AND amount_paid_usd IS NOT NULL ), unpaid AS ( SELECT * FROM invoice_base WHERE payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(amount_paid_usd,0) = 0 ), weighted AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(invoice_amount_usd * days_outstanding) / SUM(invoice_amount_usd),2) AS weighted_collection_days, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(amount_paid_usd,0)=0 THEN invoice_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS unpaid_invoice_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(amount_paid_usd,0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid_invoice_count FROM invoice_base ) SELECT weighted_collection_days, unpaid_invoice_amount, unpaid_invoice_count FROM weighted
weighted_collection_days.methodology: Calculated invoice-value-weighted days outstanding for FY2025 invoices using collection timing records; also quantified unpaid invoice count and amount.

ar_aging.query: WITH invoice_status AS ( SELECT i.invoice_id, CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE) AS invoice_date, i.invoice_amount_usd, CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date, COALESCE(fc.amount_paid_usd,0) AS amount_paid_usd, CASE WHEN fc.payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(fc.amount_paid_usd,0)=0 THEN DATEDIFF(DATE'2025-12-31', CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ELSE NULL END AS age_days FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON i.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 ) SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count, ROUND(SUM(invoice_amount_usd),2) AS invoice_amount_usd FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN payment_date IS NOT NULL AND amount_paid_usd > 0 THEN 'paid' WHEN age_days <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN age_days <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN age_days <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END AS bucket, invoice_amount_usd FROM invoice_status WHERE payment_date IS NULL OR amount_paid_usd = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'paid' AS bucket, invoice_amount_usd FROM invoice_status WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL AND amount_paid_usd > 0 ) x GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'paid' THEN 0 WHEN '1-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 WHEN '61-90' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
ar_aging.methodology: Classified FY2025 invoices as paid or, if unpaid at 2025-12-31, aged them from invoice date to 2025-12-31 into 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, and 90+ buckets.

dso_proxy.query: WITH monthly_sales AS ( SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(invoice_date AS DATE)) AS month_start, SUM(invoice_amount_usd) AS monthly_sales FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(invoice_date AS DATE)) ), monthly_collections AS ( SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS month_start, SUM(CASE WHEN fc.payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(fc.amount_paid_usd,0)=0 THEN i.invoice_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid_invoiced_amount FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON i.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ), december AS ( SELECT ms.month_start, ms.monthly_sales, mc.unpaid_invoiced_amount, DAY(LAST_DAY(ms.month_start)) AS days_in_month FROM monthly_sales ms JOIN monthly_collections mc ON ms.month_start = mc.month_start WHERE ms.month_start = DATE'2025-12-01' ) SELECT ROUND(unpaid_invoiced_amount,2) AS ar_balance_proxy, ROUND(monthly_sales,2) AS sales_period_amount, days_in_month, ROUND((unpaid_invoiced_amount / monthly_sales) * days_in_month,2) AS dso_days_proxy FROM december
dso_proxy.methodology: Limited period-end DSO proxy based on December unpaid invoiced amount divided by December invoiced sales times days in month; included because claim requested DSO but full AR ledger is unavailable.

customer_tenure.population: Top 10 FY2025 economic customer groups by revenue

evidence.query: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) AS group_customer_name, SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd, MIN(CAST(c.first_order_date AS DATE)) AS first_order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(il.line_amount_usd) DESC, COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id)) AS rn FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer p ON c.parent_customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) ), top10 AS ( SELECT *, ROUND(months_between(DATE'2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 12.0, 2) AS tenure_years FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_count, ROUND(AVG(tenure_years),2) AS average_tenure_years FROM top10
evidence.methodology: Ranked FY2025 economic customer groups by invoice-line revenue and averaged tenure in years from first_order_date to 2025-12-31 for the top 10.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: No single customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue.
Net revenue retention of 118% demonstrates best-in-class expansion.
94% of revenue is recurring subscription revenue.
Logo churn has remained below 5% annually.
Days sales outstanding is stable at approximately 45 days.
Revenue grew at a 14% CAGR over FY2023-FY2025.
Top 10 customers have an average tenure of 6 years.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT table_catalog, table_schema, table_name FROM workspace.information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'aava_deal_studio' ORDER BY table_name
metric_evidence.methodology: Verified physical objects available in the runtime schema before revenue-quality analysis.

customer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN customer_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_customer_name FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_product' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count, NULL AS min_date, NULL AS max_date, SUM(CASE WHEN product_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN product_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_customer_name FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_contract' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count, MIN(CAST(contract_start_date AS DATE)) AS min_date, MAX(CAST(contract_end_date AS DATE)) AS max_date, SUM(CASE WHEN contract_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_customer_name FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_invoice' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count, MIN(CAST(invoice_date AS DATE)) AS min_date, MAX(CAST(invoice_date AS DATE)) AS max_date, SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_customer_name FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_invoice_line' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count, MIN(CAST(service_period_start AS DATE)) AS min_date, MAX(CAST(service_period_end AS DATE)) AS max_date, SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_customer_name FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_subscription_month' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count, MIN(CAST(snapshot_month AS DATE)) AS min_date, MAX(CAST(snapshot_month AS DATE)) AS max_date, SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN arr_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_customer_name FROM metric_evidence.methodology: Quantified table coverage, date ranges, and null-key incidence for core structured sources.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT 'fact_invoice_duplicate_invoice_id' AS test_name, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM (SELECT invoice_id FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) d UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_invoice_line_duplicate_invoice_line_id' AS test_name, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM (SELECT invoice_line_id FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line GROUP BY invoice_line_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) d UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_subscription_month_duplicate_customer_month' AS test_name, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM (SELECT customer_id, snapshot_month FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month GROUP BY customer_id, snapshot_month HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) d UNION ALL SELECT 'invoice_line_missing_invoice_header' AS test_name, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.invoice_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'invoice_missing_customer' AS test_name, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'invoice_line_missing_product' AS test_name, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON il.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'collection_missing_invoice' AS test_name, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON fc.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.invoice_id IS NULL
metric_evidence.methodology: Tested for duplicate keys and missing joins across revenue, product, customer, subscription, and collection sources.

metric_evidence.query: WITH revenue_base AS ( SELECT YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS period_year, COUNT(*) AS invoice_line_count, ROUND(SUM(il.line_amount_usd),2) AS total_revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ) SELECT period_year, invoice_line_count, total_revenue_usd, ROUND(100.0 * (total_revenue_usd / LAG(total_revenue_usd) OVER (ORDER BY period_year) - 1), 2) AS yoy_growth_pct FROM revenue_base ORDER BY period_year
metric_evidence.methodology: Summed invoice-line revenue by invoice year at line grain to avoid header/line double counting and calculated year-over-year growth in SQL.

metric_evidence.query: WITH annual_rev AS ( SELECT YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS period_year, SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ), endpoints AS ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN period_year = 2023 THEN total_revenue_usd END) AS start_revenue, MAX(CASE WHEN period_year = 2025 THEN total_revenue_usd END) AS end_revenue FROM annual_rev ) SELECT 2023 AS start_year, 2025 AS end_year, ROUND(start_revenue,2) AS start_revenue_usd, ROUND(end_revenue,2) AS end_revenue_usd, 2 AS num_years, ROUND((POWER(end_revenue / start_revenue, 1.0 / 2) - 1) * 100, 2) AS revenue_cagr_pct, 14.0 AS management_claim_pct, ROUND(((POWER(end_revenue / start_revenue, 1.0 / 2) - 1) * 100) - 14.0, 2) AS difference_pct_points FROM endpoints
metric_evidence.methodology: Calculated FY2023-FY2025 CAGR directly from SQL-derived annual revenue endpoints.

metric_evidence.query: WITH rev AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) AS group_customer_name, SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer p ON c.parent_customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) ), ranked AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, group_customer_name, revenue_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC, group_customer_id) AS rn FROM rev ), totals AS ( SELECT SUM(revenue_usd) AS total_revenue_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 1 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top1_revenue_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 3 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top3_revenue_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 5 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top5_revenue_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top10_revenue_usd FROM ranked ) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * top1_revenue_usd / total_revenue_usd, 2) AS top_1_pct, ROUND(100.0 * top3_revenue_usd / total_revenue_usd, 2) AS top_3_pct, ROUND(100.0 * top5_revenue_usd / total_revenue_usd, 2) AS top_5_pct, ROUND(100.0 * top10_revenue_usd / total_revenue_usd, 2) AS top_10_pct, ROUND(total_revenue_usd,2) AS total_revenue_usd FROM totals
metric_evidence.methodology: Calculated top customer concentration percentages from FY2025 revenue aggregated to economic customer groups.

metric_evidence.query: WITH rev AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) AS group_customer_name, SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer p ON c.parent_customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) ), ranked AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, group_customer_name, ROUND(revenue_usd,2) AS revenue_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC, group_customer_id) AS rn FROM rev ) SELECT group_customer_id, group_customer_name, revenue_usd, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 ORDER BY rn
metric_evidence.methodology: Preserved top-10 contributing economic customer groups supporting concentration analysis.

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) AS snapshot_month, SUM(fsm.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON fsm.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) ), hist AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY group_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prior_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN arr_usd > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY group_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS had_positive_before FROM monthly ), classified AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, prior_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr = 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) = 0 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS new_logo_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr > 0 AND arr_usd > prior_arr THEN arr_usd - prior_arr ELSE 0 END AS expansion_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr > 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND arr_usd < prior_arr THEN prior_arr - arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS contraction_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr > 0 AND arr_usd = 0 THEN prior_arr ELSE 0 END AS churned_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr = 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) = 1 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS reactivation_arr FROM hist ), agg AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(new_logo_arr),2) AS new_logo_arr, ROUND(SUM(expansion_arr),2) AS expansion_arr, ROUND(SUM(contraction_arr),2) AS contraction_arr, ROUND(SUM(churned_arr),2) AS churned_arr, ROUND(SUM(reactivation_arr),2) AS reactivation_arr FROM classified ), begin_end AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2024-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS beginning_arr, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2025-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS ending_arr FROM monthly ) SELECT beginning_arr, new_logo_arr, expansion_arr, contraction_arr, churned_arr, reactivation_arr, ending_arr, ROUND(beginning_arr + new_logo_arr + expansion_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr + reactivation_arr,2) AS reconciled_ending_arr, ROUND(ending_arr - (beginning_arr + new_logo_arr + expansion_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr + reactivation_arr),2) AS reconciliation_diff FROM begin_end CROSS JOIN agg
metric_evidence.methodology: Computed monthly ARR movement bridge with explicit new-logo, expansion, contraction, churn, and reactivation classification and SQL reconciliation.

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) AS snapshot_month, SUM(fsm.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON fsm.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) ), cohort AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2024-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS start_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2025-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS end_arr FROM monthly GROUP BY group_customer_id HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2024-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) > 0 ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS starting_logo_count, ROUND(SUM(start_arr),2) AS starting_arr, ROUND(SUM(end_arr),2) AS ending_arr_for_starting_cohort, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(end_arr) / SUM(start_arr),2) AS nrr_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(LEAST(start_arr,end_arr)) / SUM(start_arr),2) AS grr_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN end_arr = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned_logo_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN end_arr = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),2) AS logo_churn_pct FROM cohort
metric_evidence.methodology: Calculated period-end cohort retention metrics for FY2025 from monthly ARR history at economic customer-group level.

metric_evidence.query: WITH revenue_tagged AS ( SELECT YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS period_year, SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(il.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(il.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' THEN il.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS management_tagged_recurring_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND il.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND il.service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN il.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS restated_recurring_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND (il.service_period_start IS NULL OR il.service_period_end IS NULL) THEN il.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ambiguous_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON il.product_id = p.product_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ) SELECT period_year, ROUND(total_revenue,2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(management_tagged_recurring_revenue,2) AS management_tagged_recurring_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * management_tagged_recurring_revenue / total_revenue,2) AS management_tagged_recurring_pct, ROUND(restated_recurring_revenue,2) AS restated_recurring_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * restated_recurring_revenue / total_revenue,2) AS restated_recurring_pct, ROUND(management_tagged_recurring_revenue - restated_recurring_revenue,2) AS reclassified_revenue, ROUND(ambiguous_revenue,2) AS ambiguous_revenue FROM revenue_tagged
metric_evidence.methodology: Measured both management-tagged and independently supported recurring revenue in FY2025 using invoice-line, product, and service-period evidence.

metric_evidence.query: WITH invoice_base AS ( SELECT i.invoice_id, i.customer_id, CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE) AS invoice_date, i.invoice_amount_usd, fc.amount_paid_usd, CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date, fc.days_outstanding, fc.status AS collection_status FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON i.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 ), paid AS ( SELECT * FROM invoice_base WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL AND amount_paid_usd IS NOT NULL ), unpaid AS ( SELECT * FROM invoice_base WHERE payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(amount_paid_usd,0) = 0 ), weighted AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(invoice_amount_usd * days_outstanding) / SUM(invoice_amount_usd),2) AS weighted_collection_days, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(amount_paid_usd,0)=0 THEN invoice_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS unpaid_invoice_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(amount_paid_usd,0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid_invoice_count FROM invoice_base ) SELECT weighted_collection_days, unpaid_invoice_amount, unpaid_invoice_count FROM weighted
metric_evidence.methodology: Computed weighted collection days and unpaid invoice exposure for FY2025 invoices.

metric_evidence.query: WITH invoice_status AS ( SELECT i.invoice_id, CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE) AS invoice_date, i.invoice_amount_usd, CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date, COALESCE(fc.amount_paid_usd,0) AS amount_paid_usd, CASE WHEN fc.payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(fc.amount_paid_usd,0)=0 THEN DATEDIFF(DATE'2025-12-31', CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ELSE NULL END AS age_days FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON i.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 ) SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count, ROUND(SUM(invoice_amount_usd),2) AS invoice_amount_usd FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN payment_date IS NOT NULL AND amount_paid_usd > 0 THEN 'paid' WHEN age_days <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN age_days <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN age_days <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END AS bucket, invoice_amount_usd FROM invoice_status WHERE payment_date IS NULL OR amount_paid_usd = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'paid' AS bucket, invoice_amount_usd FROM invoice_status WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL AND amount_paid_usd > 0 ) x GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'paid' THEN 0 WHEN '1-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 WHEN '61-90' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
metric_evidence.methodology: Aged unpaid FY2025 invoices and separated paid invoices for collections quality analysis.

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly_sales AS ( SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(invoice_date AS DATE)) AS month_start, SUM(invoice_amount_usd) AS monthly_sales FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(invoice_date AS DATE)) ), monthly_collections AS ( SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS month_start, SUM(CASE WHEN fc.payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(fc.amount_paid_usd,0)=0 THEN i.invoice_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid_invoiced_amount FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON i.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ), december AS ( SELECT ms.month_start, ms.monthly_sales, mc.unpaid_invoiced_amount, DAY(LAST_DAY(ms.month_start)) AS days_in_month FROM monthly_sales ms JOIN monthly_collections mc ON ms.month_start = mc.month_start WHERE ms.month_start = DATE'2025-12-01' ) SELECT ROUND(unpaid_invoiced_amount,2) AS ar_balance_proxy, ROUND(monthly_sales,2) AS sales_period_amount, days_in_month, ROUND((unpaid_invoiced_amount / monthly_sales) * days_in_month,2) AS dso_days_proxy FROM december
metric_evidence.methodology: Calculated a limited December 2025 period-end DSO proxy due to lack of explicit AR balance snapshots.

metric_evidence.query: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) AS group_customer_name, SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd, MIN(CAST(c.first_order_date AS DATE)) AS first_order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(il.line_amount_usd) DESC, COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id)) AS rn FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer p ON c.parent_customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) ), top10 AS ( SELECT *, ROUND(months_between(DATE'2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 12.0, 2) AS tenure_years FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_count, ROUND(AVG(tenure_years),2) AS average_tenure_years FROM top10
metric_evidence.methodology: Calculated average tenure for the top 10 FY2025 economic customer groups by revenue.

issues: Core revenue, subscription, customer, product, collection, and claim sources were physically present in workspace.aava_deal_studio despite initial workspace.default table-not-found context.

No duplicate invoice IDs, duplicate invoice-line IDs, duplicate customer-month ARR rows, missing invoice headers, missing customer mappings, missing product mappings, or missing collection-to-invoice links were identified in SQL validation.
Only one customer row contains a parent_customer_id; economic-group consolidation had limited but non-zero effect.
fact_invoice covers invoice dates from 2023-01-01 through 2025-12-08; revenue history prior to 2023 is unavailable in the structured billing data.
fact_subscription_month covers 2023-01-01 through 2025-12-01, allowing monthly ARR movement analysis for FY2025 but not earlier pre-2023 history.
Traditional DSO is not fully supported because no explicit receivables balance or due-date ledger table was identified; only a limited DSO proxy and weighted collection days could be calculated.

unsupported_metrics.reason: No explicit AR balance snapshot or due-date/outstanding-balance ledger was available; reported dso_days is a limited proxy rather than a full traditional DSO.
Reported logo churn is churned-and-still-inactive at period end; gross churn-event rate was not separately calculated in final scorecard.

Claims CLM-05, CLM-07, CLM-08, and CLM-11 were not evaluated because they primarily belong to earnings, growth strategy, or contract diligence workstreams rather than revenue-quality structured analysis.
